name: Zaschita svjatogo Georgija
source:
Alexey Orlov, a student of history, is forced by the requirements of the university to become a member of one of the numerous sports clubs, and it turns out that his favourite chess is also suitable.

Having decided that it is already possible to relax, Alexey meets at the first meeting the mysterious Sasha Uglova - a girl who can't play chess, but is striving with all her might to comprehend such a difficult for her strategic discipline. Along the way, it turns out that very soon there will be a mini-competition, the final prize of which is still a mystery.

Always ready to respond to the tantalising sound of mystery, Alexey decides to get this mysterious prize by all means, and at the same time to get to know his mates in the chess club better!

translation:
阿列克谢·奥尔洛夫（Alexey Orlov）是一名历史系学生，迫于大学的要求，他成为众多体育俱乐部之一的成员，事实证明他最喜欢的国际象棋也很适合。

决定已经可以放松后，阿列克谢在第一次见面时就遇到了神秘的萨莎·乌格洛娃——一个不会下棋的女孩，但正在尽全力努力理解对她的战略纪律来说如此困难的事情。事实证明，很快就会有一场小型比赛，最终的奖项仍然是个谜。

阿列克谢时刻准备着回应诱人的神秘声音，他决定不惜一切代价获得这个神秘的奖品，同时也更好地了解他在国际象棋俱乐部的伙伴们！
